people.name: Eber
people.line: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan

translations.web: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
translations.bsb: Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus; they will subdue Asshur and Eber, but they too will perish forever.”
translations.kjv: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
translations.asv: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim, And they shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber; And he also shall come to destruction.
